messages:
anya: Quick sync — need to lock the Optimize toolkit roadmap for next quarter. Main asks: batching heuristics, prefix/KV caching recommendations, quantization profiles, and eval-triggered alerts. Who's in for a prioritization call? :calendar:
mike: I'm in. prioritize batching + high-impact quantization first — customers report 2-3x cost drop. batching has infra deps tho. :+1:
sasha: Eng-platform can support caching infra but we need a clear API: eviction signals, TTLs, and customer override. avoid breaking existing caches.
jordan: From solutions: top customers want per-route quantization suggestions and safe defaults. also want eval alerts when quality regresses on prompt sets.
anya: Proposed MVP scope (trimmed):
- Smart batching: auto suggestions + per-model presets
- KV/prefix caching: two policies (auto, manual) + dashboard insights
- Quantization advisor: suggestion + recommended model variants + expected perf/cost delta
- Eval-triggered alerts: hook to eval config, baseline, and regression alerts
anya: Launch criteria: 
- Latency regression <=5% p95 vs baseline for representative prompt sets
- Documented cost reduction case for 3 workloads (batching/quant)
- End-to-end tests for caching correctness (consistency + eviction behavior)
- Pilot with 2 customers (startup + enterprise) and written feedback
- Docs, SDK examples, and rollout runbook
mike: Timelines: I can deliver batching core by mid-May if no infra blockers. quant advisor depends on profiling data from runtime (need ~2 weeks once data available).
sasha: Platform needs cache policy schema by Apr 30. also require metrics hooks: cache_hit_rate, evict_rate, prefix_kv_size. we'll need labels per-route and per-model.
anya: Prioritization proposal: Must: batching suggestions + cache infra + metrics. Should: quant advisor + per-route suggestions. Could: eval alert UI polish, automatic rollout of quant profiles. Customer asks (per-route auto-suggest) can move Should->Must if pilot customers commit.
jordan: Customer ask: Acme wants auto-rollout of recommended quant profiles with canary tests + rollback. that’s a safety feature — we should scope it as an enterprise add-on.
mike: Canary rollout tech approach: run canary with 10% traffic, monitor perplexity/LLR on prompt set, auto-rollback if delta > threshold. +1 sprint for infra and monitoring.
anya: Action items: 
- mike: draft batching RFC by Tue (thread: /docs/rfc-batching)
- sasha: publish cache policy schema + metrics hook spec by Apr 30
- jordan: line up 2 pilot customers and sample prompts
- anya: compile launch checklist, UX copy, and pilot success criteria
Sync: Friday 11am in #product. :rocket:
deploy-bot: RFC created: /docs/rfc-batching (automated)
